scope: Pinned FIFO init/clear/reserve/commit/read/release and flag/fetch OR, valid tag-position cross products, full-word atomic patterns, exclusive instructions actually executed, one/two forced STREX failures and intervening metadata/word mutations, guards/registers
limitations: Forced STREX status and selected metadata changes are controlled interleavings, not physical interrupt or multicore/concurrency proof.
FIFO geometry/tag positions are bounded and aligned, item size nonzero; invalid-pointer and divide-by-zero behavior are not portable contracts.
Original compiler/instruction identity, complete firmware linking and physical behavior remain unproven.
